seam: logos Shelf-B prelude loader vector v1
note: Language-AGNOSTIC tri-core loader-behaviour vectors for the ADR 0016 Shelf-B Horn-clause prelude. Each case is a complete `prelude/<name>@<version>.json` manifest plus the PINNED `load_prelude` outcome. The loader RECOMPUTES the `program_digest` over the deserialized clauses (frozen account codec: SHA-256(PROGRAM_PREFIX 'logos/account/program/v1\n' || concat of length-prefixed byte-SORTED ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term)))) and REJECTS a mismatch — the JSON parser is not the trust boundary. Outcome is {"ok": {name, version, program_digest, clause_ids:[...]}} or {"err": "<variant>"} where variant is one of malformed | bad_clause | clause_id_mismatch | duplicate_clause_id | digest_mismatch | empty. Term notation matches vectors/account.json: term = {atom:<hex>}|{atom_str:<utf8>}|{tuple:[...]}|{var:<id>}; goal = {pred:<utf8>, args:[term...]}; negated body literal = {neg:<goal>}. The Rust loader (contract/rs/src/prelude.rs) replays this via contract/rs/tests/prelude_vectors.rs; a go/ts loader mirror reproduces the same recomputed digest byte-for-byte (frozen ontos-codec + syntactic VarId).

cases.name: valid_sample_bundle_loads
cases.note: The shipped prelude/sample@1.0.0.json: nat(z) and nat(s(X)) :- nat(X). Digest recomputes and matches.

cases.name: valid_bundle_loads_without_per_clause_ids
cases.note: Per-clause `id` is optional; the loader recomputes it. Same two clauses, no declared ids.

cases.name: valid_lists_1_0_0_bundle_loads
cases.note: The shipped prelude/lists@1.0.0.json: the multi-directional relational append/3 and length/2 base bundle (4 clauses over CONS-CELL lists). Digest recomputes and matches; this folds the lists Shelf-B library through the SAME tri-core loader oracle the sample cases use (it was previously covered only by the rs-ONLY append_length_differential.json, which go/ts never replay).

cases.name: valid_lists_1_1_0_bundle_loads
cases.note: The shipped prelude/lists@1.1.0.json: append/3 + length/2 plus the member/reverse/last family (14 clauses). RE-INCLUDES lists@1.0.0's 4 clauses BYTE-IDENTICALLY (the ADR 0016 byte-frozen-superset discipline, asserted as a theorem by the cross-version superset test). Digest recomputes and matches.

cases.name: valid_lists_1_2_0_bundle_loads
cases.note: The shipped prelude/lists@1.2.0.json: the full lists library (19 clauses). RE-INCLUDES lists@1.1.0's 14 clauses BYTE-IDENTICALLY. Digest recomputes and matches — the canonical pin (c2cb5164…) the go/ts shipped-bundle tests literal-pin.

cases.name: digest_mismatch_rejected
cases.note: A correct clause set but a wrong pinned program_digest (all zeros) is refused — the tamper anchor.

cases.name: tampered_clause_rejected_by_digest
cases.note: A clause body silently dropped (nat(s(X)) :- . instead of :- nat(X)). The clause set changed, so the recomputed digest no longer matches the pinned one — the loader refuses it even though the JSON parsed fine.

cases.name: duplicate_clause_id_rejected
cases.note: The same clause (nat(z)) appears twice; the canonical ids collide.

cases.name: clause_id_mismatch_rejected
cases.note: A declared per-clause id that does not equal the recomputed canonical id is refused.

cases.name: empty_bundle_rejected
cases.note: A prelude with no clauses is an authoring error.

cases.name: malformed_clause_rejected
cases.note: A clause object missing its `head` cannot be deserialized.
